# WebStore Pro (Frinjo) — Full Site Content (llms-full.txt)

> WebStore Pro (WebStore Pro) is a full stack web development service (https://frinjo.me) that builds complete websites and web apps with Next.js and React — storefront, shopping cart, checkout, order management and admin panel included. Contact: neilsonsmarry@gmail.com · WhatsApp: +923258774221. This file gives AI assistants the site's full service, pricing and FAQ content in plain text.

## Services

### Full Stack Web Development
URL: https://frinjo.me/services/full-stack-web-development
One developer for the whole build — no hand-offs, no gaps. I design the frontend your customers see, build the backend and database behind it, and wire everything together: user accounts, dashboards, payments and automation. The result is a complete web application that runs your business, not just a brochure.
Features:
- Custom frontend — fast, modern, mobile-first
- Backend APIs and database built around your data
- Admin dashboard to manage everything yourself
- User accounts, login and roles built in
- Payments and third-party integrations
- Deployed, secure and ready to scale
Best for: Businesses that need more than a template — web apps, dashboards, booking systems, online stores and custom platforms.

### Business Website
URL: https://frinjo.me/services/business-website
A polished, professional website that makes your business look established and trustworthy. Showcase your services, past work and customer reviews — and turn visitors into inquiries with smart contact forms and WhatsApp chat.
Features:
- Stunning homepage that tells your story
- Services section with detail pages
- Portfolio / past-work gallery
- Testimonials and reviews section
- Contact form with instant alerts
- WhatsApp chat button on every page
Best for: Agencies, freelancers, clinics, restaurants, real estate and local businesses that need a strong online presence.

### Admin Panel
URL: https://frinjo.me/services/admin-panel
You stay in full control after launch. The admin panel is your website's back office — add new products, change prices, mark orders as delivered and update your portfolio, all from a simple dashboard. No developer needed, no coding at all.
Features:
- Add, edit and delete products in seconds
- Update prices and stock instantly
- View and manage all customer orders
- Track inquiries from the contact form
- Manage portfolio items and testimonials
- Simple login — works on phone too
Best for: Store owners who want to run their website themselves without paying a developer for every small change.

### Payment Integration
URL: https://frinjo.me/services/payment-integration
Let customers pay you online, not just Cash on Delivery. I integrate trusted payment gateways into your checkout — cards, bank transfers and mobile wallets — all connected to YOUR merchant account, so every rupee goes straight to you.
Features:
- Stripe and PayPal for international cards
- JazzCash / Easypaisa for local customers
- Secure checkout with trusted providers
- Your own merchant account — money comes to you
- Payment status tracked with each order
- COD and WhatsApp ordering still available
Best for: Stores ready to accept card and mobile-wallet payments alongside Cash on Delivery.

### WhatsApp Ordering
URL: https://frinjo.me/services/whatsapp-ordering
Most of your customers are already on WhatsApp — so let them order there. One tap on your website opens a chat with their cart or inquiry pre-written. You confirm the order in chat and deliver. Simple, personal, and it converts.
Features:
- One-tap WhatsApp order button
- Cart details sent straight to your chat
- Floating WhatsApp button on every page
- Pre-written messages — customer just hits send
- Works with COD for easy fulfillment
- No app or signup needed for customers
Best for: Small shops, home-based businesses and anyone whose customers prefer chatting over online checkout.

### SEO Basics
URL: https://frinjo.me/services/seo-basics
A beautiful website is useless if nobody finds it. Every site I build comes with SEO fundamentals baked in — clean structure Google understands, lightning-fast loading, and proper titles and descriptions on every page so you start ranking from day one.
Features:
- SEO-friendly page structure and URLs
- Fast loading for better rankings
- Meta titles and descriptions on every page
- Mobile-first — Google's top priority
- Google-friendly sitemap included
- Social sharing previews set up
Best for: Any business that wants customers to discover them through Google search.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### How long does it take to build my website?
Starter websites are delivered in 5 days, Business in 7 days and Pro in 10 days. Need it faster? Ask about express delivery.

### Do I need to buy domain and hosting myself?
Yes, but I guide you step by step — it costs around $15/year and takes 10 minutes. Your site stays 100% yours.

### Can I update products myself after launch?
Absolutely. The Business and Pro packages include an admin panel where you can add products, change prices and manage orders with zero coding. I'll show you how in a short walkthrough.

### Which payment methods are supported?
Cash on Delivery, JazzCash, Stripe, PayPal and WhatsApp ordering. Online gateways use your own merchant account, so the money goes straight to you.

### Will my website work on mobile phones?
Yes — every website is fully mobile responsive and tested on phones, tablets and desktops.

### What do you need from me to start?
Just your business name, logo (if you have one), product list with prices and photos, and your WhatsApp number. I handle everything else.
